about: The hall: every dimension the builder reads. Metres, degrees. Change a number here and rebuild.
axes: The hero line's track runs along +Y toward the dock; unit_0's centre is the origin; the floor is z 0. The trays face +X (the side a body steps out over): the station's aisle is on +X, the wall of stock behind the units on -X.

carton.note: a two-part carton: the tray (its walls to the seam, a collar inside rising to the rim, a moulded insert with a pocket down to body_mark's height) and the hood that comes down over the collar to the seam. body_mark: where a body stands or kneels in the tray, in the tray's frame (+x the body's left, -y its front)

track.note: flush in the floor: roller tops at z 0, so a tray stands on the rollers as on the floor

stack.note: the hood stack: slot j is column floor(j/2) (from the line outward), level j mod 2

lectern.note: the station: whoever runs the line stands on its -Y side and looks down the line (+Y)

gantry.post_note: the west rail has no floor post along the units, so no post stands behind one unit's head and not another's; both rails' north ends hang from the roof steel on a drop tube

cycle.note: the fraction of run: where each part of the move happens. A hood rides the ring between hood_rides.

pendant.note: the crane's hanging control on its own slim mast beside the lectern, at hand height, its button facing the station (-Y)

stream.note: closed cartons; travel (m) rolls them toward the dock; they turn west outside the door and come round again far down the hall. At travel 0 (and every 3.6 m) the hero spur's junction is clear, with cartons 1.8 m either side of it

swap.note: swap 0..1: to 0.3 the open tray at unit_0 rolls west along the spur to the main track; 0.3..0.9 it rides the main track out through the dock; 0.25..1 a fresh closed carton rolls up the inbound track (the line's own track, continued down the aisle) into unit_0's place

hall.note: lane 0 is the hero aisle, a canyon between racks that holds the hero line alone; lanes 1..8 are the open west floor, `rows` lines deep. line_00 is the hero; the others count lane by lane from the canyon outward, row 0 nearest the dock. small: the hall cut short for a quick build (two rows of two lanes, the far end at y0)

racks.note: one carton to a bay: every stock carton stands in its own cell, 1.2 m apart, so in the hero aisle a boxed twin stands straight behind every unit and the wall behind each unit is the same picture (uprights 0.6 m either side of each unit's axis). The canyon's west wall runs two bays past unit_9 so the last units have the same wall behind them. near_y: the stretch of the aisle rows built with the near carton

sun.note: the afternoon sun through the dock door: from +Y, 10 degrees round toward +X; the build finds the elevation at which the shadow of the door's head falls at patch_end_y, so the sunlit patch covers unit_9's tray and stops short of unit_8's

meter_cabinet.note: a mechanical counter in a sheet steel cabinet; its door and window face +Y, the dock

crowd.note: every other line takes its moving parts (crane, hoods) from one of `variants` copies, by row; copy v runs crowd_run minus v * phase_step

cameras.note: pos and aim in world metres; lens in mm on a 36 mm sensor; 'ortho' an orthographic scale in metres
